change_summary: Material in-season sensing recovery completed. The 19:06:00 CDT capture identity matches status, burst and vision; all six expected owner cameras are capture-healthy with 3/3-frame bursts. Together with the 18:06:20 CDT identity, this supplies the required two consecutive healthy identities after the 17:06 pcl_e2_back_deck failure, so J01 is closed. Four views had good visibility and moderate-to-high detectability with no visible Jubilee signal; pcl_e2_back_deck and pcl_e2_bay_mouth had fair visibility/low detectability and remain UNKNOWN rather than negative. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope live-player checks used two isolated samples 26.525 and 26.543 seconds apart at 19:59–20:00 CDT. Playback positions and rolling endpoints advanced with visible scene progression. Fairhope reported currently playing live, so no Seek to live action was needed; exact delay remains unknown. No collecting, searching, handheld lights or feeding-bird signal was visible; darkness leaves biological evidence UNKNOWN and neither Fairhope beach is visible. NGOFS2 guidance is unchanged, direct local bottom oxygen and observed nearshore transport remain UNKNOWN, and fresh indexed searches found no credible September 8 first-person Jubilee report.
